inspiration: Outcome stinger ladder: separate end states for perfect, won, finished and lost, each with its own sample and dialog (pysollib/game/__init__.py:2476, 2492, 2506, 2512). Shape for sound-music stingers.
Priority-gated sound: a stinger plays at high priority and a looping sample blocks lower-priority cues (pysollib/pysolaudio.py:94). Shape for ambience-vs-stinger mixing.
Loss note that names the help used rather than only the failure (pysollib/game/__init__.py:2513). Shape for death presentation without a penalty screen.
Short reject cue for an illegal action (data/sound/nomove.wav). Shape for combat input feedback.
Several art families for one card back shape (data/images/cards/bottoms, 11 sets). Shape for cosmetic variety with one silhouette.
Light and dark icon variants in one folder (data/images/toolbar/material/info.txt:3). Shape for dark-UI legibility.
Translation tables holding game names and UI text in separate files (po/de_games.po, po/de_pysol.po). Shape for string tables.
